observations.behavior: Replaces the previous per-interval `relativedelta` additions with a dictionary lookup and timedelta arithmetic. This unifies sub-daily scheduling into one branch.
observations.posthog_connection: This could change alert check timing behavior for hourly/real-time checks; it also adds backlog skipping when scheduled time is in the past.

observations.behavior: Adds an explicit skip-backlog guard that advances the next scheduled instant by multiples of the interval until it exceeds current time.
observations.posthog_connection: Could prevent missed alerts from accumulating indefinitely while still preserving phase relative to last successful run.

observations.behavior: Adds a new parametrized test case named "hourly_skips_backlog" asserting that an overdue hourly schedule jumps forward rather than repeating immediately.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against unintended behavior where delayed execution would cause repeated immediate re-checks instead of resuming cadence.

observations.limitations: Only P1 chunk provided; no changes shown for daily/weekly/monthly paths or migration compatibility. No runtime assertions or integration tests are visible. The tier depends on whether this backfill-skipping was previously absent and its actual effect on reliability.
